title: How to style an oversized T-shirt: 7 easy looks for every day
excerpt: Oversized tees look relaxed, not sloppy, when the rest of the outfit is sharp. Seven simple ways to wear one, from college to a chai date.
content:
An oversized T-shirt is the easiest thing in your wardrobe to throw on, and also the easiest to get wrong. The trick is simple: when the top is loose, keep something else in the outfit neat. Here are seven looks that work, whether you're heading to college, a café or a weekend trip to the hills.

1. Straight jeans and white sneakers

The classic. Pick straight or relaxed-fit jeans, not skinny ones, so the proportions match the boxy tee. Roll the hem once, add clean white sneakers, and you're done.

2. The half tuck

Tuck just the front few inches of the tee into your waistband. It shows your waist, makes your legs look longer and stops the shirt from looking like a sack. Works with jeans, chinos and cargos.

3. Cargo pants for the street look

Cargos and an oversized tee are made for each other. Go tonal (black on black, olive on beige) and let a back print do the talking.

4. Over a hoodie or under an open shirt

In winter, wear the tee over a thin hoodie, or wear an open flannel or overshirt on top. Layering keeps the oversized fit and adds warmth without bulk.

5. With shorts for summer

Pair with shorts that end just above the knee. Too-long shorts plus a long tee hide your whole frame, so keep the shorts shorter and the shoes simple: slides or low sneakers.

6. Let the print lead

A graphic or Hindi line on the back is a conversation starter. Keep everything else plain (solid bottoms, no other logos) so the print stands out, especially in photos.

7. For women: knot it or tuck it

Tie a small knot at the side, or tuck it fully into high-waist jeans or a skirt. An oversized tee with biker shorts and sneakers is an easy airport or errand look.

Getting the size right

An oversized tee is already cut loose, so take your usual size. Go one size down only if you want it closer to a regular fit. Each product page has a size chart in inches, so check chest and length before you order.
